description: Specs for the Run Image Recognition page (dev-only) — displays all image template matching attempts during a workflow run, including confidence scores, matched regions, and annotated screenshots showing detection results.

groups.name: Image Recognition Results Browsing
groups.description: Developers use this page to review all image template matching attempts that occurred during a workflow run. Each entry represents a moment where the automation engine tried to locate a visual element on screen using image recognition. The user needs to see the full list of attempts, understand which succeeded and which failed, and view the confidence scores to assess matching reliability. This is the primary diagnostic tool for tuning image-based automation.

assertions.description: The user can see a table or list of all image recognition attempts from the run, with each entry showing the template name, match result, and confidence score, providing a comprehensive view of how visual element detection performed

The user can click on any image recognition entry to view detailed information including the annotated screenshot showing where the template was detected (or attempted), matched region coordinates, and full confidence metrics

The user can see confidence scores for each image matching attempt, allowing them to distinguish between strong matches, weak matches, and failed attempts, which is essential for calibrating detection thresholds

groups.name: Visual Debugging with Annotated Screenshots
groups.description: The core value of this page is visual debugging. When image recognition fails or produces unexpected results, the developer needs to see the actual screenshot with annotations showing where the template was matched (or where the system looked). Annotated screenshots with bounding boxes over the detected region are the single most useful debugging artifact for image-based automation.

assertions.description: The user can view annotated screenshots that visually show where on the screen the image template was detected, with bounding boxes or highlights indicating the matched region, making it immediately obvious whether the detection was accurate

When image recognition failed to find a match, the user can see the screenshot that was captured at the time of the attempt, helping them understand why the template was not found (wrong screen state, occluded element, resolution mismatch, etc.)
The user can see the pixel coordinates of matched regions, allowing them to verify that detections correspond to the correct UI elements and identify cases where matches are in unexpected positions

groups.name: Empty State Handling
groups.description: Many workflow runs do not involve image recognition at all (purely command-driven or AI-only workflows). The page must clearly communicate when no image recognition data exists for the selected run, guiding the developer to understand this is expected rather than an error condition.

assertions.description: When no image recognition attempts were recorded for the selected run, the user sees a clear empty state message explaining that no image recognition data exists for this run
